'''Boltzmann''' is an open-world [[NPC]] in [[Startorch Academy]]. He is a researcher who can be seen talking to a student by the training grounds near [[B.1.N.G.O.]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Boltzmann:''' You know, the trashcan was just a temporary body for B.1.N.G.O. We were strapped for resources back then. You know how it goes...
:'''Boltzmann:''' Its new chassis was completed a long time ago. But B.1.N.G.O. refused to transfer over. Said everyone had gotten used to its... unique look.
:'''Boltzmann:''' It insisted it wouldn't like looking  down on everyone from some giant frame. Said cleaning the testing grounds would be a nightmare with a bulky body!
:'''Boltzmann:''' After that, it just turned and shuffled away. No looking back. It was... kind of majestic.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* Boltzmann's name likely comes from {{W|Ludwig Boltzmann}} who was an Austrian mathematician and theoretical physicist in the 19th century.
